hostid.description: ID of the host that the web scenario belongs to. Property behavior: constant; required for create operations.

name.description: Name of the web scenario. Property behavior: required for create operations.

agent.description: User agent string that will be used by the web scenario. Default: Zabbix.

authentication.description: Authentication method that will be used by the web scenario. Possible values: 0 - (default) none; 1 - basic HTTP authentication; 2 - NTLM authentication; 3 - Kerberos authentication; 4 - Digest authentication.

delay.description: Execution interval of the web scenario. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 1m, 2h, 1d), or a user macro. Default: 1m.

headers.description: HTTP headers that will be sent when performing a request.

http_password.description: Password used for basic HTTP, NTLM, Kerberos, or Digest authentication.

http_proxy.description: Proxy that will be used by the web scenario given as http://[username[:password]@]proxy.example.com[:port].

http_user.description: User name used for basic HTTP, NTLM, Kerberos, or Digest authentication.

retries.description: Number of times a web scenario will try to execute each step before failing. Default: 1.

ssl_cert_file.description: Name of the SSL certificate file used for client authentication (must be in PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Name of the SSL private key file used for client authentication (must be in PEM format).

status.description: Whether the web scenario is enabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

verify_host.description: Whether to validate that the host name for the connection matches the one in the host's certificate. Possible values: 0 - (default) skip host verification; 1 - verify host.

verify_peer.description: Whether to validate that the host's certificate is authentic. Possible values: 0 - (default) skip peer verification; 1 - verify peer.

uuid.description: Global unique identifier, used for linking imported web scenarios to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given. Property behavior: supported if the web scenario belongs to a template.

httpField.description: The HTTP field object defines the name and value that is used to specify the web scenario variables, HTTP headers, and POST fields or query fields.

name.description: Name of header/variable/POST or GET field. Property behavior: required.

value.description: Value of header/variable/POST or GET field. Property behavior: required.

scenarioStep.description: The scenario step object defines a specific web scenario check.

name.description: Name of the scenario step. Property behavior: required.

no.description: Sequence number of the step in a web scenario. Property behavior: required.

url.description: URL to be checked. Property behavior: required.

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects. Possible values: 0 - don't follow redirects; 1 - (default) follow redirects.

headers.description: HTTP headers that will be sent when performing a request. Scenario step headers will overwrite headers specified for the web scenario.

posts.description: HTTP POST variables as a string (raw post data) or as an array of HTTP fields (form field data).

required.description: Text that must be present in the response.

retrieve_mode.description: Part of the HTTP response that the scenario step must retrieve. Possible values: 0 - (default) only body; 1 - only headers; 2 - headers and body.

status_codes.description: Ranges of required HTTP status codes, separated by commas.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Accepts seconds, time unit with suffix, or a user macro. Default: 15s. Maximum: 1h. Minimum: 1s.

query_fields.description: Query fields - array of HTTP fields that will be added to URL when performing a request.

tag.description: Web scenario tag name. Property behavior: required.
